name: Flat Dish Made of Marbled Clay
material: Stoneware with marbled clay and transparent glaze
summary: Using the marbling technique, in which light- and dark-colored clays are kneaded together (jiaotai; 絞胎), this dish is entirely covered with a transparent glaze, further enhancing the contrasting effect.
